QuestInfo.name: The Legendary Crystal
QuestInfo.0: You've arrived in Ardentmill. Ask Grant how to put the crystal together.
QuestInfo.1: Grant sent you to Intaglio, the master jeweler of Ardentmill.
QuestInfo.2: You found Intaglio the master jeweler.

0.0: Howdy. I'm Grant, the elder of Ardentmill. What can I do you for?\r\n#L0##bI seek he who can craft a Lambent Crystal.#l\n#k
0.1: A Lambent Crystal, eh? I haven't heard that name since I was first starting out as a craftsman. Speak to Intaglio at the bottom of town. He's your man.

no.0: Intaglio is probably the only man in Maple World who can craft that crystal.

1.0: Hello, gorgeous! Don't you have the most divine eyes I've ever seen!\r\n#L0##bI understand you can craft a Lambent Crystal.#l\n#k

npc.0: Head to the bottom of Ardentmill and go right. Intaglio's the fella standing by the big jewel.
